FN-7LHDV2E-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 188
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/23/2024
House Bill 188 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board
of Education and the local boards of education to adopt policies regarding long-term suspension
or expulsion.
Page 1
